name: copilot-dependency-advisory
description: This worker is triggered by the `AFTER_DOWNLOAD` event of Artifactory. The first time an artifact tagged with the `copilot.advisor.repo` and `copilot.advisor.repoBaseBranch` properties is downloaded, it opens a GitHub issue in that repo and assigns it to GitHub Copilot's coding agent to vet the new dependency. Artifacts without both properties are a NOP.
